data.name: C2X
data.description: C2X is a green methanol project developer majority-owned by A.P. Moller Holding with Maersk and ENEOS as shareholders, headquartered in London. Its flagship Beaver Lake Renewable Energy project in Louisiana (with SunGas Renewables) will convert forestry residues into ~500,000 tonnes/year of bio-methanol for shipping and aviation, while capturing and geologically sequestering ~1 million tonnes/year of surplus biogenic CO2 to generate CDR credits as a co-product.
